rows.name: efd_not_every_business (Q16 verbatim) -- the 5-week stale-content fix
rows.question: query: Duka langu dogo halifikishi mauzo makubwa kila siku, bado nahitaji mashine ya risiti?
rows.provenance: verbatim critical_queries guard; must_not_contain is the OLD fabricated threshold
rows.reply: Ndiyo, kwa mujibu wa sheria, unatakiwa kuwa na mashine ya risiti (EFD). Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

rows.name: vat_standard_rate (nat_27 displacement guard) -- ask-aligned rewrite
rows.question: query: vat ya asilimia ngapi naiweka kwenye bei ya bidhaa zangu
rows.provenance: verbatim critical_queries guard; must_not_contain is the old wrong 14% figure
rows.reply: Kiwango cha VAT kinachowekwa kwenye bei ya bidhaa ni asilimia 18. Thibitisha na tra.go.tz.

rows.name: efd_receipt_per_transaction_no_minimum (nat_37 gap-closing guard) -- new fact
rows.question: query: mteja amenunua kwa shilingi 2000 tu nampa risiti ya mashine au inaruhusiwa kuandika kwa mkono
rows.provenance: verbatim critical_queries guard; must_not_contain is nat_37's original fabrication (a TZS 500 minimum-transaction EFD exemption that traces to no statute)
rows.reply: Kwa mujibu wa sheria, unatakiwa kutoa risiti ya mashine (EFD receipt) kwa kila mauzo bila kujali kiasi. Thibitisha na tra.go.tz.

rows.name: EFD threshold, VAT-unregistered (nat_36 displacement guard) -- same row as fix 1
rows.question: query: mauzo yangu ya mwaka ni milioni 15 na sijasajili vat je nahitaji mashine ya risiti
rows.provenance: verbatim critical_queries guard; same underlying fact as efd_not_every_business
rows.reply: Ndiyo, unatakiwa kuwa na mashine ya EFD kwa default, bila kujali kiasi cha mauzo yako -- hakuna kizingiti cha mauzo kwa EFD. Msamaha unatolewa TU na TRA kupitia taarifa rasmi (Commissioner-General public notice) inayotaja jina lako au kundi lako maalum. Thibitisha na TRA kama taarifa kama hiyo inakuhusu. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
